name: burnigator-dev-tools
description: Developer tooling only (lint, format, tests). Burnigator itself has no build step and no runtime dependencies.

scripts.lint:js: npm run lint:js:syntax && npm run lint:js:eslint
scripts.test:php: php tests/event_auth_test.php && php tests/map_clean_test.php && php tests/stats_test.php && php tests/dashboard_test.php && php tests/map_revision_test.php
scripts.test:js: node tests/timetable-core.test.js && node tests/deeplink.test.js && node tests/exposure-check.test.js
scripts.test: npm run test:php && npm run test:js && npm run test:sh && npm run test:http
scripts.check: npm run lint:php && npm run lint:js && npm run format:check && npm test
